title: poincare-explainer: interactive explainer of LLM Orchestration with Geometry-Aware Memory
description: Interactive, open-source explainer and TypeScript reference library (poincare-ball) for 'LLM Orchestration with Geometry-Aware Memory' (IEEE ICBDML 2026, doi:10.1109/ICBDML68582.2026.11544690): nine scroll-driven chapters on hyperbolic memory, orchestration and synthesis, with every figure computed in the browser. Written after the paper from its description; the original experimental system is not released. Live at https://dhruvmojila.github.io/poincare-explainer/
